cohort: The study included live babies with gestational age between 230/7 and 316/7 weeks, including extremely low gestational age (ELGA) and extremely low birth weight (ELBW) neonates.
finding: The data revealed that almost half of extremely low gestational age/extremely low birth weight neonates had neither low mean arterial pressure readings nor clinical signs of impaired perfusion, with treatment decisions often varying individually rather than based on consistent evidence.
